responsibility: Implements miscellaneous shared tree-SSA maintenance utilities that many passes use when restructuring CFG and SSA. It manages deferred edge-to-PHI argument mappings for redirected edges, flushes pending PHI arguments after edge rewrites, provides helpers to replace an SSA-defining statement’s LHS while preserving debug semantics, supports statement/value rewriting involved in address-taken and scalarization updates, and hosts generic pass hooks for address-taken recomputation and related SSA-form cleanup.
same_name_distinction: This .c file implements the generic Tree SSA maintenance utilities themselves, such as deferred edge-to-PHI mappings, edge redirection flushing, SSA-LHS replacement helpers, and address-taken update machinery. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa.h, it is not the common pass-facing declaration surface for those shared SSA utilities.
